name: Legal market crosswalks: practice areas, federal case codes, states, federal districts and counties
description: The shared keys that join every Probative dataset. One record per practice area (our taxonomy of consumer and business practice areas, each linked to the FOLIO Area of Law class it matches, the federal nature-of-suit codes of its cases, the site's practice pages and the datasets that measure its demand, supply, rules and money), per federal nature-of-suit code, per state and territory (FIPS and postal codes, Census region and division, federal circuit and districts), per federal judicial district (our district key, the Federal Judicial Center code and the court's CM/ECF id), per county and county equivalent in the 50 states, DC and the territories (Puerto Rico's municipios and the county equivalents of Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa and Midway: FIPS code, the federal district and statutory division it belongs to, its metro or micro area and its Census population), per former county code older sources still use (with the current counties that took its area), and per documented source code that names a place under another key (EEOC's WQ for Wake Island) or is not a place at all (military mail, the freely associated states, the VA's unplaced addresses, U.S. Courts' outside-the-U.S. code). Every county's district is read from the statute and checked against the counties U.S. Courts lists under each district in its bankruptcy Table F-5A.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Legal market crosswalks: practice areas, federal case codes, states, federal districts and counties (Version 2.3.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24181503

distribution.name: crosswalks.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: crosswalks.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: crosswalks-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in crosswalks-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to crosswalks.csv on id.

recordSet.name: crosswalks
recordSet.description: The records of Legal market crosswalks: practice areas, federal case codes, states, federal districts and counties, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state or territory code the record belongs to, or US for the national tables (practice areas, case codes, datasets, special keys)

field.name: table
field.description: STATE, DISTRICT, COUNTY, FORMER (a county code no longer current that older sources still use), ALIAS (another code a source uses for a place that has a key here), SPECIAL (a code a source uses that is not a U.S. place), PRACTICE, NOS (federal nature-of-suit code) or DATASET

field.name: code
field.description: The record's key in its table: a postal code, a district key (CAC, NYS), a 5-digit county FIPS code, a source's alias or special code (WQ, OTHER), a practice-area id, a 3-digit nature-of-suit code or a dataset id

field.name: status
field.description: P read from the primary source; S secondary: a nature-of-suit code no longer on the current U.S. Courts list (kept for older cases), a Virginia independent city placed by 28 U.S.C. 127(c) using the U.S. Courts county lists, or a former county code in a multi-district state placed by the district of its successors; D Probative's own classification (practice areas and dataset links)

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
